s.how: Cut 1kg russets into thin fries and soak in cold water for 30 minutes, then dry well. Fry at 140C for 5 minutes, rest, then fry at 190C until golden and crisp. Salt straight away and serve hot.

s.note: for the royal bathers in Zamunda
s.how: Beat 125g butter with 100g sugar and 1 tsp rose water, then mix in 200g flour. Roll thin, cut into rounds and press crushed dried rose petals on top. Bake at 170C for 9 minutes until just crisp at the edges.

m.note: two beef patties, special sauce, sesame seed bun
m.how: Mix 100g mayo, 2 tbsp relish, 1 tsp mustard, paprika and a dash of vinegar. Smash 8 thin patties from 800g mince, add cheese. Build each in a three-piece sesame bun with sauce, shredded iceberg, diced onion and pickles.

w.note: the McDowell's dessert menu, totally original
w.how: Cook 3 diced apples with 30g butter, 3 tbsp sugar and 1 tsp cinnamon for 8 minutes, then cool. Cut 2 sheets puff pastry into quarters, fill, fold into triangles and crimp. Egg wash and bake at 200C for 20 minutes.

d.how: For each shake, blend 3 scoops vanilla ice cream with 150ml cold milk until thick and smooth. Pour into a chilled tall glass and serve with a wide straw. Make four, one after the other, so they stay thick.
